<!-- Follow doc/contribute.md: obtain explicit maintainer acceptance of this
feature's scope before submitting its implementation PR. A roadmap entry or
an open request is not acceptance. Do not include private notebooks or logs. -->

Follow the [contribution policy](../../doc/contribute.md) before implementation.

## Problem and user benefit

Describe the problem, who is affected, and how this helps export quality or
nontechnical/multilingual users.

## Proposed scope and alternatives

Describe the smallest useful change and alternatives. Link related issues/PRs
and dependencies; distinguish new capabilities from a bug or export-quality fix.

## Simplicity, reliability, security, and licensing

Explain complexity/maintenance cost, offline behavior, safe defaults, data-loss
risks and warnings, and any new dependencies with their licensing/attribution.

## Acceptance criteria and validation

Describe expected behavior, synthetic reproduction/expected output where useful,
affected export formats, and feasible human validation. State environment limits.

## Maintainer decision

Pending explicit maintainer acceptance. An AI suggestion or contributor assertion
is not that decision; link the maintainer's scope decision in the implementation
PR after it has been given.
